latestVersion.changelog:
- Added support for two download modes: single merged Markdown file (--md) and full Markdown package (ZIP with images and tables).
- Updated Quick Start instructions to document both modes.
- Expanded documentation with a "Download Modes" section explaining when to use each mode.
- Clarified output location for both MD and ZIP extraction.
- Improved privacy notice for sensitive document handling.
